AuditConfig.description:
The audit block every Registry Stack product shares: the hash key, then a
`file` (the default) or `stdout` destination, with rotation and retention
for a file.

hashKeyCustody.description:
Who provisioned the key. Absent means `operator-provisioned`.
`development-generated` marks a key a development tool made.

hashKeyRef.description: Secret reference to the audit hash key.

path.description:
The absolute path of the active audit file. Required for a `file`
destination, and refused with `stdout`.

retentionDays.description: Days a rotated file is kept, for a `file` destination. Default: 90.

rotateBytes.description:
Size at which the active file rotates, in bytes, for a `file`
destination. Default: 100 MiB.

AuditDestinationKind.description: The configured audit destination kind, as written in product configuration.

oneOf.description: One JSON line per entry on standard output, flushed per entry.

AuditKeyCustody.description: Who provisioned the audit hash key.

oneOf.description: A development tool generated the key.

EnvironmentSecretProviderConfig.description: The environment secret provider. It takes no settings.

ExternalId.description: An identifier another system issues, written exactly as its issuer gives it.

root.description:
Absolute directory holding one file per secret. A name may be a
relative link that stays below this directory, through at most 8 links.
The file it reaches must be a regular file with one hard link, owned by
the runtime user with mode 0400 or 0600, or owned by root with no
access beyond group read (0440 or 0640) when the runtime is not root.
A process that declared development loads a file with looser read or
mode bits and logs a warning.

GatewayConfig.description: The gateway's view of the service and of the host it sits in front of.

authority.description:
The `:authority` the browser uses, as `host` or `host:port`. Default:
the host and port of `publicOrigin`. Signed-in routes match only this
authority, so a caller that reaches the host by an internal name never
meets the session routes.

checkTimeoutMilliseconds.description: How long the gateway waits for the check. Default: 3000.

hostFilters.description:
The host's own HTTP filters, by the name the host's chain gives them.
Every signed-in route switches them off, except where its upstream
keeps one.

service.description: How the gateway reaches the service's two listeners.

GatewayServiceConfig.description: The service's address as the gateway reaches it.

checkPort.description: The port of the service's check listener.

host.description: The service's host name or address.

publicPort.description: The port of the service's public listener.

IssuerConfig.description:
The OpenID Provider the service signs people in with. Every endpoint is
written out: there is no discovery.

attemptTimeoutMilliseconds.description:
How long the service waits for the issuer's token and revocation
endpoints. It must be below `gateway.checkTimeoutMilliseconds`, so a
check whose token is still valid is answered before the gateway gives
up on it. Default: 2000.

authorization.description: The authorization endpoint the browser visits.

endSession.description: The end-session endpoint the browser visits.

id.description: The expected `iss` of every ID token, compared exactly.

jwks.description: The signing key set the service calls.

revocation.description: The revocation endpoint the service calls.

token.description: The token endpoint the service calls.

ListenerBind.description: Socket address the runtime listens on, written host:port with an IP address host ([addr]:port for IPv6).

ListenerNetworkExposure.description: The operator-declared private network placement of an HTTP listener.

LocalId.description: A local identifier: a lowercase letter, then up to 63 lowercase letters, digits, `_`, or `-`.

LogLevel.description:
The operational log level. The vocabulary is closed so configuration cannot
turn on debug output or dependency logging.

ModuleConfig.description: One product a page calls, reached under one path prefix.

audience.description: The audience of the token the service attaches to calls to the module.

id.description: The module's name in this file, unique among its modules.

prefix.description:
The path prefix the module owns: it starts with `/`. Ending with `/`,
it holds the paths below it; without, also that exact path.

signIns.description: The kinds that may call the module. Omitted, every kind may.

upstream.description:
The host's cluster the gateway forwards the module's calls to. Required
when the file has a `gateway` block.

PageConfig.description: A page route: pages under the prefix need a session of one kind.

prefix.description:
The path prefix the pages sit under: it starts with `/`. Ending with
`/`, it holds the paths below it; without, also that exact path.

signIn.description: The kind of session the pages need.

upstream.description:
The host's cluster the gateway forwards the pages to. Required when the
file has a `gateway` block.

PrivateListenerConfig.description:
The listener of a runtime that declares its TLS termination and network
exposure.

burst.description: Requests admitted at once before the average applies.

requestsPerMinute.description: Requests admitted per minute, on average.

RateLimitsConfig.description:
The service's own request limits. It reads neither peer addresses nor
forwarded headers, so it cannot tell one browser from another before
sign-in: a per-address limit on the sign-in routes belongs at the gateway.

globalSignIn.description:
One limit shared by everyone starting a sign-in. A start is charged
only once its return path is accepted. A callback is never charged,
because it needs the pending sign-in a charged start created. Default:
900 a minute, burst 300.

perPerson.description:
One limit for each signed-in person, shared by all their sessions. It
covers the sign-in that names the person (once, when the first hop
returns) and `GET /session/me`. It does not cover sign-out, which
always ends the session, or the gateway check, which leaves limits on
module calls to the modules and the gateway. Default: 120 a minute,
burst 30.

SecretProvidersConfig.description:
The secret providers a runtime enables. A reference is resolved only by a
provider declared here: `secret:file/name` under `file.root`, and
`secret:env/NAME` only when `environment: {}` is present.

environment.description:
Enables `secret:env/NAME` references, read from the process
environment. Declared as an empty mapping: `environment: {}`.

file.description: Enables `secret:file/name` references, read from files under `root`.

SecretReference.description: An exact secret reference: secret:file/name, resolved under secretProviders.file.root, or secret:env/NAME, resolved only when secretProviders.environment is declared.

absoluteLifetimeSeconds.description:
The longest a session lasts, whatever renewals it makes. Default:
28800.

idleLifetimeSeconds.description:
How long a session may go without a request that presents it before it
ends, between 300 and `absoluteLifetimeSeconds`. When the store is
full, sessions past this are the first to make room. Default: 1800, or
`absoluteLifetimeSeconds` when that is shorter.

maximumPendingSignIns.description:
The most sign-ins in progress the service holds at once. It must hold
every sign-in `rateLimits.globalSignIn` admits within
`signInLifetimeSeconds`. Default: 10000.

maximumSessions.description: The most signed-in sessions the service holds at once. Default: 10000.

renewBeforeSeconds.description: How long before an access token expires a call renews it. Default: 60.

signInLifetimeSeconds.description:
How long a started sign-in may take to return from the provider.
Default: 600.

TlsTermination.description:
Declares the trusted transport boundary for a runtime's plaintext HTTP
listener. Production listeners require operator-controlled upstream TLS
termination; direct plaintext is limited to the explicit loopback-only
development mode.

oneOf.description:
Plaintext on a loopback bind, behind a proxy on the same host. Valid
in every posture. It is placement only: it relaxes nothing a product
relaxes under `development-loopback`.

UpstreamConfig.description: Where the gateway forwards the calls of one module or page route.

keepHostFilters.description: Names from `gateway.hostFilters` that stay on for this route.

prefixRewrite.description: The prefix the gateway puts in place of the route's own.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long the gateway waits for the upstream's answer. Default: 30.

Url.description: An absolute http or https URL with a host preserved as written, no user information, and no backslash, whitespace or control character. DNS case and equivalent IPv6 literals are permitted.

claims.description:
The ID-token claims who-am-I returns, a closed list. Default: `sub`,
`name`, `email`, `email_verified`.

checkListener.description:
The address the gateway's authorization check calls. It takes the
public listener's `tlsTermination` and `networkExposure` and must
differ from `listener.bind`.

gateway.description:
How the gateway reaches the service and the host's clusters, read only
by `gateway envoy`. When present, every module and page names its
`upstream`.

listener.description: The listener for the service's public routes.

logLevel.description:
Operational log level. Defaults to `info`; accepted values are
`error`, `warn`, and `info`.

modules.description: The products a page calls, each under one path prefix.

pages.description: The page routes that need a session of one kind.

personAudience.description:
The audience several modules share, written once. A module takes it by
writing `audience: person`.

publicOrigin.description:
The browser-facing origin of the gateway, such as
`https://app.example`: an https URL with no path, query, or fragment;
plain http is accepted only on a loopback host under
`development-loopback`.

additionalProperties.description: One kind of sign-in and the confidential client it uses at the provider.

clientId.description: The client identifier at the provider.

clientSecretRef.description: Secret reference to the client secret, under a declared provider.

scopes.description: Scopes requested beside `openid`, which the service always requests.

signIns.description: One confidential client per kind of sign-in, keyed by kind.

propertyNames.description: The kind's name, the key it is written under.

title: Registry Stack session service runtime configuration
